mathematics.kind: primary independent mathematical derivation, not independent second review
mathematics.normalization: Use paper [-1,1] x [0,1], folded on x=0 into Q=[0,1] x [0,1]. Each picture is schematic; panel display offsets and the 1.8:1 drawn choice boxes are not extra length givens.
mathematics.cut_invariant: Without an extra fold/rearrangement, each straight cutting pass is supported by one line in Q. Removing pieces or interrupting a cut cannot increase the number of supporting lines. Two passes therefore supply at most two distinct cutting lines in Q. This support-line argument does not assume that a later cut through a disconnected region creates only one segment.

A.discard: Discard bottom and top triangles at folded edge x=0. Reflection gives one central V at each of the two horizontal boundaries.

B.discard: Discard the triangle touching the fold with vertices (0,.2),(.4,.5),(0,.8). Reflection produces one internal diamond.

C.discard: Clip the two outer corners of Q at x=1. Reflection clips all four corners of the original rectangle.

E.discard: The first cut removes the bottom folded corner, giving a central bottom V after unfolding; the second clips the upper outer corner, giving the two upper corner chamfers. No top-bottom symmetry is required by one vertical fold.

mathematics.D_impossible: The right half of D contains a full V at the top and a full inverted V at the bottom, each strictly away from x=0 and x=1. The four slanted segments have four distinct support lines. In the actual frozen coordinates their top and bottom vertices have y=2.25-.28 and y=1.25+.28 and their respective base halfwidth is .27. Each V needs both slopes; a top supporting line and bottom supporting line of the same slope have different intercepts. Thus at least four straight passes are necessary in Q; two cannot make D. Coloring a slope class cannot identify displaced parallel lines as one pass.
mathematics.semantic_scope: The source specifies one fold and two freely chosen straight cuts. The scissors in Solid174 are an illustrative tool, not an additional specified cut or direction.

human_semantics: Only D is colored. On an annotation reading its four distinct cutting lines remain impossible. On a literal colored-paper reading D remains impossible (already fails geometry), while the uncolored blank source and A/B/C/E are unchanged and retain their explicit two-cut constructions. Therefore D remains the unique answer under both readings.
